Real, checked finding: server_broadcast() sends one identical snapshot to every client regardless of team; true fog needs per-team filtered snapshots, not client-side hiding. Favorable finding: client-to-team lookup and variable-length hero counts already exist, lowering real implementation risk once built. 5 open design decisions named. NORTHSTAR.md §30. commit 280d44a.

title: Scoped true server-authoritative fog of war (no code, per founder's own hold-the-build direction)
